title: The State of the World's Land and Water Resources for Food and Agriculture
evidence: Soil organic carbon, soil structure, infiltration and moisture retention are coupled indicators of land degradation and resilience.
guidance: Protect soil cover, increase organic inputs, and monitor carbon and water indicators together.

title: Global Assessment Report on Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services
evidence: Land-use change is a major direct driver of biodiversity loss; habitat connectivity and diversity support species persistence.
guidance: Retain and reconnect native habitat across working landscapes, not only isolated reserves.

title: Climate Change 2022: Impacts, Adaptation and Vulnerability
evidence: Climate warming, changing rainfall and extremes alter species ranges, seasonal water availability and ecosystem vulnerability.
guidance: Use locally appropriate diverse habitat and water-retention measures to reduce exposure and increase adaptive capacity.

title: The 10 Elements of Agroecology
evidence: Diversification, synergies and recycling can improve ecological functions while maintaining productive agricultural land.
guidance: Combine crop diversity, perennial elements and residue recycling, then measure ecological and production outcomes.
